name: Lightdash Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted Lightdash open-source core with dbt-native metrics, SQL exploration, charts and dashboards; no software usage quota or per-seat fee for the OSS edition.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own compute, database, data warehouse and maintenance; infrastructure and query costs are separate. MIT applies to the open-source core, while enterprise-only code is separately licensed. Vendor-hosted Cloud Pro, AI agents, enterprise security and support are paid, not included.
